tasks.title: Reference-anchored resolution normalization of viscosity + curl (in place)
tasks.spec: Make `viscosity` and `curl` resolution-invariant by reinterpreting them INTERNALLY — NO new public fields, NO dual-field arbitration. Let N_ref = DEFAULTS.SIM_RESOLUTION (confirm = 128). Let w,h be the sim FBO dims; N_actual = min(w,h) = simResolution; the screen-isotropic cell size is h_cell = 1/min(w,h). VISCOSITY coefficient: today applyViscosity uses `uAlpha = VISCOSITY * dt * Math.max(w,h)` (~FluidEngine.ts:2644). Replace with the BYTE-IDENTITY-PRESERVING, O(N^2)-invariant gauge: `uAlpha = VISCOSITY * dt * Math.max(w,h) * (Math.min(w,h) / N_ref)`. This is EXACTLY today's value whenever min(w,h)==N_ref (any aspect ratio), and scales as O(N^2) with resolution (physically-consistent nu*dt/h^2). CURL/confinement: today curl is uploaded raw. Scale it by `(N_ref / Math.min(w,h))` so it is byte-identical at N_ref and resolution-normalized beyond. FACTOR both coefficient computations into PURE functions (no GL — e.g. `viscosityAlpha(viscosity, dt, w, h, nRef)` and `curlScale(curl, w, h, nRef)`) so they are node-testable. Keep the viscosity GLSL ((L+R+T+B)/(1+4*uAlpha)) and the vorticity GLSL UNCHANGED — coefficient/uniform math only. Retune ONLY the 4 simResolution-overriding flow presets (GasFlare/Venturi 160, Karman/TeslaValve 192 in registry.ts) so their feel matches their pre-change tuning; default-resolution presets need NO change by construction. Document the gauge + the 4 retuned values in the ADR.

tasks.title: Confinement boundary bugfix — attenuate confinement near solids (intentional change)

tasks.title: [DEFERRED] MacCormack velocity advection — dedicated program, 2-pass, limiter+guards
tasks.deferred_reason: All three plan reviewers (codex/grok/agy) flagged MacCormack as too underspecified and UNVERIFIABLE by the node gate for an unattended loop (its acceptance — dipole vortex retention, NaN soak — is GPU-readback-only). Implement in a focused, human-reviewed session AFTER the Phase 0 harness exists to validate it. The corrected design is recorded below so that session can execute it directly.
tasks.spec: DESIGN OF RECORD (for the future human-reviewed session, not this loop): The single `advectionProgram` is SHARED by advectVelocity/advectDye/advectScalar — composing a MACCORMACK keyword onto it would corrupt dye(1024^2)/scalar. Therefore compile a DEDICATED velocity-MacCormack program (separate compile, MACCORMACK keyword + MANUAL_FILTERING as applicable) used ONLY in advectVelocity; advectDye/advectScalar keep the plain program. TWO-PASS choreography: pass A = forward semi-Lagrangian advect velocity into the existing `velocitySource` sim-res scratch FBO (phi_hat); pass B reads velocity.read (phi^n) + velocitySource (phi_hat), does an INLINE backward trace + the Selle-2008 limiter (clamp the corrected value to the min/max of phi^n's bilinear fetch stencil at the forward-backtrace position) + first-order fallback guards, writing velocity.write. velocitySource is reused transiently (viscosity repopulates it afterward — advection runs before viscosity; assert the ordering in a comment). SOLID guard: use the inline-mask VALUE already computed in the advection shader (container/obstruction solidity via inlineMaskGLSL) — NOT uSolidNeighbors (which is not bound in advection). OPEN-EDGE guard: plumb uOpenEdges into advectVelocity via flowOpenEdges() (currently divergence-only) and fall back to first-order within 2 cells of an open edge. Keep the ±1000 velocity clamp backstop. Velocity-only; NO dye MacCormack; NO runtime Material; NO public advectionScheme field. The #else (semi-Lagrangian) source must stay byte-identical.
